[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Umbriss''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who trained [[Sadic]] as their [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. The Sith utilized Sadic as their personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until Umbriss incurred the wrath of another Sith Lord by the name of [[Darth Angral]] until sometime before<ref name="Codex" /> [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Umbriss's transgressions caused the far more powerful Sith Lord to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Umbriss and take their wealth and [[Umbriss's estate|estate]]. Angral also took Sadic on as his own apprentice, who pledged eternal loyalty to his new [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umbriss's first and only mention is in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which features an in-game Codex. The entry for their apprentice, Lord Sadic, detailed Umbriss's demise.<ref name="Codex" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] players receive this entry after defeating Sadic in the class mission "Showdown with Lord Sadic" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Showdown">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Showdown with Lord Sadic|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
